notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time; none returned a statement by Pete Sessions on AI, AI risk, superintelligence, a pause, or China talks. The site:sessions.house.gov search returned no pages from his site, so the earlier direct check of sessions.house.gov (from the previous attempt: home page and press-release listing pages 1 to 3, covering November 2024 to 17 September 2026) is kept as the official-site check. The only AI mention found there is in the 30 January 2026 release on his bipartisan identity fraud bill with Rep. Bill Foster (https://sessions.house.gov/media/press-releases/congressman-pete-sessions-introduces-bipartisan-legislation-to-combat-identity-fraud-and-theft), whose background text (not a quote from Sessions) mentions 'artificial intelligence driven deep fakes'; that is deepfakes, level D at most, and not his own words, so it is left out of statements. The April 2026 article on a House subcommittee roundtable about AI fears (min.house.gov, 16 April 2026) does not mention Sessions. No source found showing he sponsored or co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (introduced by Sanders and Casar) or signed any other House AI letter.
